rationale: Preregistered engineering floors for the v2 authored release, per docs/hard-ai/phasing/M5-FLOOR-PREREGISTRATION-v2.md. The allowedMiss vector is the frozen v1 budget (v1 offered minus v1 minimumEarned per family) and contract.ts refuses any other value in either direction; minimumEarned is DERIVED from this manifest's own offered counts (tactics 63-6=57, invariants 15-1=14, home-mate 28-0=28, economy 20-0=20, summon-disruption 14-1=13, home-fortify 6-0=6) so that no v2 floor can be set from an observed outcome. engineSourceSha256 and weightsSha256 preregister the build these floors are declared against: assertContractBuild refuses any other build rather than crediting it. They are hashJson(engineSourceHashes()) and weightIdentity(DEFAULT_WEIGHTS) read off this worktree without running a search; if the Hard engine or the weights change before the measurement, this contract must be rewritten with the new hashes and re-committed ALONE before hard:suite:phasing:measure is run. This file must be committed by itself, with no result.json, cases.jsonl, started.json, failure.json, ledger line or any path under a results directory in the same commit, and the measurement must be a separate, later run; resolveContractCommit refuses an untracked or working-tree-modified contract, which is the mechanism that makes this a preregistration rather than a description. No engine outcome, corpus, opening or sealed set was read to write it.
